name: Harvest
description: Harvest is a time tracking and invoicing software designed for teams and freelancers to track project hours, log expenses, monitor budgets, and bill clients seamlessly.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Includes basic time tracking and invoicing for 1 user on up to 2 active projects.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Includes unlimited users, unlimited active projects, automated reminders, and integrations (billed annually at $10.80/mo or monthly at $12/mo).

best_for: Positioned for creative agencies, consultancies, professional services, and freelancers needing streamlined time tracking tightly connected to project budgets and client invoicing.
pros: Seamless connection between tracked hours, project budgets, and client invoices
Built-in online payment processing through Stripe and PayPal integrations
Visual project budget burn-down tracking and capacity reporting
Clean, user-friendly interface with lightweight desktop and mobile timers
cons: Free plan is strictly limited to 1 user and 2 active projects
Lacks native employee monitoring features like screenshots or keystroke activity
No built-in shift scheduling or GPS geofenced location tracking
features: One-click time tracking across web, desktop, mobile, and browser extensions
Automated timesheet submission, review, and manager approval workflows
Client invoicing generated directly from billable hours and tracked expenses
Integrated online payments via Stripe and PayPal
Project budget tracking with visual progress and burn-down alerts
Team capacity and utilization reports to balance workloads
Expense tracking with receipt attachment and multi-currency support
50+ native integrations with Asana, Trello, Slack, QuickBooks, and Xero

alternatives.name: Toggl Track
alternatives.description: A time tracking tool with one-click timers, background activity tracking, and profitability reporting.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting flexible time tracking and deep profitability analytics

alternatives.name: Clockify
alternatives.description: A time tracking and timesheet app with attendance, scheduling, and a free plan for unlimited users.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting free time tracking for unlimited users with basic billing

alternatives.name: Hubstaff
alternatives.description: A workforce management and time tracking tool with automated timesheets, activity monitoring, and payroll integrations.
alternatives.best_for: Remote teams needing proof-of-work tracking and automated contractor payroll
